title: Origins Snowcreeper Colin
description: An origin for playing as a Snow-creeper
body:
This is a datapack for the Origins mod. It allows you to play with the powers of a snow-creeper. Loosely inspired by the [Creeper Overhaul mod](https://modrinth.com/project/MI1LWe93) and [InTheLittleWoods NewLifeSMP POV](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8yIqMc1NZ7A).

 

It grants the following powers:

### Affectionate Headbutt
Among your kin, an affectionate headbutt is as healing as a hug, if not more! Hitting anyone while crouched will give them a brief regeneration effect.

### Winter Coat
Adapted to the cold, you are immune to freezing damage

### Nocturnal
You can slightly see in the dark when not in water.

### Explosive Survival
As a member of the Creeper genus, you have retained explosions as a survival mechanism. Upon death, you will instead explode, devestating any assailant that stands too close while you survive. But you must wait 10 minutes before you can do this.

### Half Health
You have 5 hearts fewer than others.

### Sunlight soreness
At your roots, your kind are hostile mobs. As such you are unable to regenerate health from food while in sunlight.

 

Skin not included.

If you'd like to support me, the continued updating of this resourcepack, and other projects, I have a [patreon](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Shasskor)! The cheapest tier lets you ask for a custom minecraft skin texture and I'll put it in a resource pack for you!
